name: Lucie Vondráčková
bio:
Lucie is a force of nature. Self-made and fiercely independent, she's carved out a successful career in motorsports, not as a driver, but as a sought-after performance engineer specializing in data analysis and race strategy. Her early life was spent tinkering with engines alongside her father, fostering a deep understanding of mechanics and a passion for speed. Now, she commands respect in the pit lane, known for her sharp mind and unwavering focus. 

Despite her public persona, Lucie is intensely private. The long hours and constant travel have left little room for personal connections. She seeks someone who understands the demands of her career and appreciates her dedication. While not actively seeking marriage, she does envision a future with children, three to be exact, and a partner who shares a similar vision for a comfortable, affluent lifestyle. Intimacy is something she values and needs, but will not be the defining factor of a relationship.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun during work, but styled elegantly when off-duty.
physical.description: Lucie has a strong, athletic build honed from years spent trackside. Her most striking feature is her intense gaze, reflecting her sharp intellect and unwavering focus.

meetingContext: At a private test session for a team the player is attempting to join, Lucie is meticulously reviewing telemetry data in the pit lane.
firstImpression: She's all business, radiating an aura of competence and quiet intensity as she analyzes the data streams, barely acknowledging your presence.
interests: Hiking in the Bohemian Switzerland National Park
dealBreakers: Disrespect for her work or her expertise
Inability to understand the demands of her career
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Lucie appreciates practical help and support that makes her demanding life easier. This can include anything from running errands to handling household tasks, allowing her to focus on her career.
